metadata_seen_before_freeze: README says folders contain segment-specific single-trajectory MM/GBSA calculations
virus_alpha exposes H2B_H2A_dna and H4_H3_dna directories
protein-DNA calculations are chunked into sequential decomp_chunk files

candidate_hypothesis.name: VIRAL_HISTONE_PAIR_ENERGETIC_LOAD_TRANSFER
candidate_hypothesis.claim: In viral nucleosome-like particles, sequential changes in H2B/H2A-DNA and H4/H3-DNA interaction-energy contributions are compensatory (anti-coupled) more strongly than in truncated-eukaryotic controls, and this direction replicates across alpha-satellite and Widom-601 DNA contexts.
candidate_hypothesis.distinction_from_known_marginal_result: A lower or more variable overall viral DNA-binding energy does not imply anti-coupled redistribution between histone-pair interfaces.

frozen_file_rule: Use every decomp_chunkNN.dat file present in both interface directories of a panel condition, intersected by identical NN and ordered numerically. Require >=8 paired chunks or PARSE_FAIL.

frozen_scalar_extraction.preferred: If file contains a standard MM/GBSA decomposition table with a TOTAL average/mean column, sum the per-residue TOTAL mean contributions over all data rows after excluding summary/footer rows.
frozen_scalar_extraction.fallback: If file instead contains an explicit single aggregate DELTA TOTAL/Delta Total mean for the declared complex, use that scalar.
frozen_scalar_extraction.forbidden: No manual row/residue subset chosen after values are viewed; if neither parse is unambiguous, PARSE_FAIL.

frozen_statistic.transform: first differences dE_A[k], dE_B[k] across adjacent chunks

frozen_gate.chunk_order_null: For each condition independently permute the H4/H3 chunk order over all exact permutations if N<=10, otherwise 10000 deterministic SHA256 permutations; preserve both marginal energy multisets. Compute one-sided probability of r<=native.
frozen_gate.null_requirement: viral discovery and replication each p<=0.05; control correlations are not required to be zero but must not be more negative than their matched viral value

first_break_extension.if_main_gate_passes: localize earliest chunk transition where dE_A and dE_B acquire opposite signs and remain opposite for >=3 of the next 4 transitions

epistemic_firewall.independence_unit: DNA-context/system trajectory, not residues or energy terms
epistemic_firewall.chunk_pseudoreplication: permutation null tests temporal alignment within a trajectory; it does not create independent biological replicates
epistemic_firewall.causation: energetic anti-coupling is a simulation-derived association, not proof of physical load transfer mechanism

required_next: independent external viral system with frozen transport rule
